acquisition method: The data were acquired in top speed mode with 3 s cycles
alkylation reagent: alkylated using 10 mM iodoacetamide for 10 min at room temperature kept in dark
alkylation concentration: alkylated using 10 mM iodoacetamide for 10 min at room temperature kept in dark
cleavage agent: Trypsin was added in a ratio of 1 unit of trypsin per 20 unit of sample and kept for overnight digestion at 37 °C
collision energy: fragmented using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with 35% normalized collision energy
enrichment method: the rest was further processed for TiO2 based enrichment of phosphopeptides
fractionation method: The lyophilized peptides were reconstituted in bRPLC solvent A (10 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate, pH 8.5) and fractionated on Xbridge C18 5 um 250 × 4.6 mm column
fragmentation method: fragmented using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with 35% normalized collision energy
instrument: analyzed on Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer interfaced with Proxeon Easy-nLC 1000 system
labeling: A mass spectrometry-based quantitative phosphoproteomic and proteomic approach involving iTRAQ labeling to measure differences in the phosphorylation state of proteins upon PfCDPK1 knockdown was employed
reduction reagent: reduced using DTT at a final concentration of 5 mM at 60 °C for 30 min
reduction concentration: reduced using DTT at a final concentration of 5 mM at 60 °C for 30 min
